Author: dajoey
Name: Gluttony Combo
Punchline: Lalalazy fork of Wrath Combo - XIVCombo for very lazy players.
Description: Gluttony Combo is a lalalazy-branded fork of Wrath Combo. Condenses combos and mutually exclusive abilities onto a single button - and then some. All upstream credit to Team Wrath / PunishXIV.
Changelog:
v1.0.4.327 (2026-11-05) [testing]
- **Fight Brain Stage 1a: a fight forecast that only logs.** While a boss fight is on, the plugin builds a forecast of the next 3-30 s from BossMod Reborn's own public timeline and hints plus a plain scan of the enemies' visible casts, outside the Crucible boards. It writes `FB|` lines to the game log (forecast entries appearing and expiring, a shadow cast-gate line when a hard cast would still be running at the moment a drawn danger zone under the character demands a move, and the healer's raidwide mitigation question with both answers in one line: the plain code rule's pick and the relay's shadow pick beside it), and a small click-through countdown strip lists the forecast (code forecasts only; no shadow pick is shown until it passes its grade). The shadow questions go to the LAN Jev relay (PvE mode, its own daily cap) and can be switched off by clearing the relay URL in the auto-rotation settings. Nothing here presses an action: the rotation's behavior is unchanged, and the mitigation and cast-gate answers are recorded for grading only.
- **Removed the dead "Use boss-mod targeting when active" option.** It needed a priority-target endpoint that stock BossMod Reborn does not provide, so it could never change a target and only wrote a log line on every load. The setting, its greyed-out UI state and its offline cases are gone; the DPS targeting mode dropdown behaves exactly as before.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.326 (2026-11-03) [testing]
- **Action replacement follows the game's own hook plumbing again.** Upstream WrathCombo replaced its hand-written hook delegate with the game's GetAdjustedActionId delegate type and reads the action manager through the game's accessor at call time instead of a pointer cached at startup, so action replacement keeps working when the game moves or re-creates the action manager; that upstream change (1e64c866) is merged. The fork's replacement behavior, throttle, mandragora hold and error reporting are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.325 (2026-11-02) [testing]
- **Treasure dungeons: no AoE while the mandragora pack is alive.** The five mandragoras (onion, egg, garlic, tomato, queen) in the treasure dungeons have to die one at a time, in order, for the full reward, and an AoE on the clumped pack breaks the order. While any of them is alive, the auto-rotation runs its single-target rotation only, and any action that can hit more than one enemy is held: cleaves, circles, cones, lines and ground areas (Circle of Scorn, Glare IV, Flare Star, Salted Earth and the like, including damage-and-heal actions such as Assize), plus actions whose follow-up is an AoE (Standard Step and Technical Step, the primal summons and Enkindles, Living Shadow). A held weave is skipped; a held GCD is replaced by the button's current single-target action (Glare IV becomes Glare III, Standard Step becomes Cascade), and readiness checks report held actions as not ready so rotations move on to their next priority. The same applies to single-target buttons pressed by hand. Heals, mitigation (Reprisal included) and party buffs are not held, and an AoE button pressed by hand still does what it says. Normal rotation resumes as soon as the last mandragora is dead. Covers the Hidden and Lost Canals of Uznair, the Shifting Altars of Uznair, both Lyhe Ghiah dungeons, the Excitatron 6000, the Shifting Gymnasion Agonon, Cenote Ja Ja Gural and the Vault Oneiron.
- A dance already in progress when the pack appears cannot finish until the pack is dead, because its finish is an AoE.
- A held GCD with no single-target action on its button waits instead: Red Mage holds Grand Impact, and while Grand Impact is ready the game shows it in place of Jolt III, so that GCD waits until the pack is dead or the buff ends (instant casts, Verstone, Verfire and the melee combo still go; a hand press of that button does nothing meanwhile).
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.324 (2026-11-02) [testing]
- **A pull started by another plugin no longer stalls on the opener's first self-buff.** While a plugin such as Henchman, AutoDuty or Lazy Fate Automation drives the rotation, the out-of-combat restriction already lifted for attacks, but a self-only action with a long cooldown from a damage preset still waited for combat. When the opener's first step was one of those (Machinist's Reassemble or Flamethrower before the first shot), the rotation targeted the enemy and then waited for an action it was never allowed to press, so the character stood at the target until it was pressed by hand. Now, while another plugin is in control and the chosen target is an enemy within 25 yalms, any self-usable action the damage rotation picks fires out of combat as part of the pull: the opener's buffs, and also a heal dump or shield the rotation chooses at that moment. An enemy further away is one the plugin is still travelling to, so buffs are not spent on it early. With no plugin in control, with no enemy targeted, or with the enemy out of reach, the out-of-combat rule is unchanged: heal dumps, shields and other self-only actions from a damage preset still wait for combat.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.323 (2026-11-01) [testing]
- **A cancelled heal cast is no longer counted as a completed one.** The healer raidwide locks (White Mage Medica II/Medica III, Astrologian Aspected Helios/Helios Conjunction, Scholar Succor/Concitation) treated "the cast bar was up and then went away" as a finished cast: a cast cancelled a moment in marked the timed regen as owning that raidwide for its whole duration and started the raidwide-shield cooldown, so the heal was never re-cast for the hit. Completion is now the action actually registering as used, so a cancelled cast is claimed and re-cast, and a finished cast still releases the lock exactly as before.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.

v1.0.4.322 (2026-10-28) [testing]
- **BossMod status checks survive a missing or half-loaded BossMod.** Upstream WrathCombo reorganized its BossMod IPC into shared helpers with null-safe fallbacks; that rework (d9c63e468) is merged, so the active-preset module walk, autorotation, custom-queueing, smart-target and AI-targeting checks answer false cleanly when BossMod's rotation window or action queue is absent, instead of erroring partway through the walk.
- BossMod Reborn keeps being read through its own IPC (active preset verdict, AI targeting, manual-queue setting); those reads are unchanged.
- Testing channel only; the production channel is unchanged. Not verified in play yet.
